title: Sidebars and lists flat: the TOC and backlinks boxes, the overview sidebar's box, the folder listing rows and the Blog index's intro and post cards become ruled sections on the ground
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)'. Ruling: operator-no-cards-except-floats. The token --gamecult-rule exists after home-flat. Line numbers are from 410485e; re-read by selector.

Surfaces: .toc, .backlinks (1225-1238; left TOC on desktop, right backlinks on standard content pages); .gamecult-overview-sidebar-inner (1257-1272, mobile 1489-1491; the Studio/Praxis/Participate sidebar on /, /Projects and content pages with sidebarGroups); .page-listing .section-li > .section (1364-1380; the engine folder listing on /Docs and tag pages); .gamecult-blog-index-intro and .gamecult-blog-card (827-873; /Blog, emitted by the engine's AutoIndexFolder with classPrefix gamecult-blog, GameCult-Quartz quartz/components/AutoIndexFolder.tsx 193-223).
The ritual block's .right.sidebar .toc (160-170) undoes the TOC card with border 0, border-radius 0, background transparent, box-shadow none; those four lines are dead after this cut and go with it.

Mechanism: each box becomes a section with border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule), no inset, its existing heading as the label. Rows in a list (folder listing, blog posts) each carry the top rule, so the rule is the separator. Hover on a blog post turns its title orange (var(--secondary)) instead of filling the card.
Pills untouched; masthead untouched; the engine is not edited (the listing and blog markup are the engine's, only the site's rules change).

827-837: the .gamecult-blog-index-intro, .gamecult-blog-card card rule (border, radius, background, shadow) deleted whole; 855-857 .gamecult-blog-card { overflow: clip } deleted; 865-873 .gamecult-blog-card-link:hover fill deleted.
1225-1238 .toc, .backlinks: border-radius, border, background (4 lines), padding, box-shadow (3 lines) deleted; replaced by the two lines in adds.

1257-1272 .gamecult-overview-sidebar-inner: padding, border-radius, border, background (5 lines), box-shadow (3 lines) deleted; display, flex-direction, gap stay. 1489-1491 (mobile padding) deleted whole.
1368-1380 .page-listing .section-li > .section: padding, border-radius, border, background (6 lines) deleted; display, grid-template-columns, gap stay.

keeps_moves: .toc h3, .backlinks h3 (1240-1247): the uppercase tracked heading stays as the section's label.

.gamecult-overview-group (1311-1314) keeps its border-top; its colour becomes var(--gamecult-rule) (was rgba(89,183,255,.08)). .gamecult-overview-group:first-child keeps no rule, because the sidebar's own top rule now sits above it.
The engine's listPage.scss and AutoIndexFolder.tsx: untouched.
adds: custom.scss .gamecult-overview-sidebar-inner: padding: 0.9rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule); (on phones the sidebar sits under the article; the rule separates it).

custom.scss .page-listing .section-li > .section: padding: 0.9rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule); and .page-listing .section-li { margin-bottom: 0 } (1364-1366) so rows meet at the rule.

custom.scss .gamecult-blog-index-intro: padding becomes 0 0 0.4rem (was 1.25rem 1.5rem 1.35rem). .gamecult-blog-card-list gap becomes 0 (851-853). New: .gamecult-blog-card { border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule); } .gamecult-blog-card-link padding becomes 1.2rem 0 1.3rem (861). New: .gamecult-blog-card-link:hover h2 { color: var(--secondary); } (hover is a colour change, the brand's one accent).
docs/brand-design-language.md '## Surfaces': one sentence that list rows (blog index, folder listings) and sidebar sections separate by the same top rule, by selector.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the sidebars' and lists' grouping through --gamecult-rule; the engine owns their markup (TOC, Backlinks, FolderContent, AutoIndexFolder) and GameCultOverviewSidebar.tsx owns the overview markup.
inputs: the engine's section-li and gamecult-blog-* markup
outputs: TOC, backlinks and overview sidebar as ruled sections on the ground
/Docs listing and /Blog index as ruled rows with orange-title hover
derived_state: every separator colour is derived from --gamecult-rule; the sky .08 literal in the overview group is gone
hover state on a blog post is derived from --secondary; no fill is painted
forbidden_writers: no background, border (other than border-top), border-radius or box-shadow on .toc, .backlinks, .gamecult-overview-sidebar-inner, .page-listing .section, .gamecult-blog-card or .gamecult-blog-index-intro
no change to the pills, the masthead, the engine or any content file
